summary: The one suite failure was a test-isolation problem, not a game bug: the live menu kept 'Firefly catch' chosen from the previous run, so Play correctly started it. I made the test clear the menu first; all 10 tests now pass. Label clamping and ellipsis-free panels (session 12 work) pass their tests.

failures.what: The Mini game menu keeps its previous choice across runs, and nothing in the dashboard says so beyond the menu text (minor UX note)
failures.steps: Choose 'Firefly catch' in the Mini game menu, stop, later press Play
failures.expected: Play starts the chosen game (this is what happens); the only issue is that the earlier test assumed an empty menu
failures.actual: Play starts Firefly catch, as designed. No game bug found.

tests_added: Play with nothing chosen starts Jump in, Stop ends it (now clears the menu choice first, so it is independent of earlier runs)
